name: full_snapshot
description: Materialize one complete 14-cell table state for every ordered release and retain every Iceberg snapshot.

input.workload: the same 38-observation real-revision workload used by B0

state.write_action: INSERT OVERWRITE the complete accumulated state once per release
state.rebuild_policy: drop and recreate only the B1 experiment table before a complete run

invariants: one complete state is committed for every ordered release
every committed state contains exactly one row per cell_id
the final B1 state equals the B0 latest-vintage state on all H6 observation columns
every one of the 38 H6 observations is addressable in at least one retained snapshot
no Iceberg snapshot expiration is executed for B1
the same ordered H6 input produces the same logical snapshot states
